title: RC - REGULATORY COMPLIANCE - AI - Senior Professional
jobDescription:

The opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and detailoriented AI Model Evaluation Consultant with strong expertise in validating AI/ML models, Generative AI (GenAI) systems, and multiagent workflows within GxPregulated and qualitycritical environments. The ideal candidate will ensure the reliability, fairness, robustness, and regulatory compliance of AI solutions while supporting crossfunctional teams in designing, testing, and maintaining productionready, inspectionready AI systems.

This role is responsible for leading AI model evaluation and validation activities across the full model lifecycle, including model development, training, testing, deployment, and postdeployment monitoring, in alignment with GxP principles, riskbased validation, and data integrity expectations.   • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to identify model improvement opportunities and risk mitigations.
  • Document evaluation results, limitations, risks, and acceptance criteria in a clear, auditready manner.

Short Description:

Department - Enterprise Architecture (EA)

Position Type - Full-Time / Technical Leadership

Reports To - Senior Director (or) Principal Architect, Enterprise Architecture


Description:

We are seeking a director level Enterprise Architect to lead identity, API, and AI security governance across the global enterprise, operating at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure & platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

This role is chartered by establishing governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills, while partnering closely with platform, infrastructure, and data/AI teams to shape the future of secure, scalable AI adoption across Ford.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on technical credibility across cloud, AI, and security domains with the maturity of leadership to build and grow a large, cross-functional team of polyglot architects from the ground up, in a greenfield security architecture practice.


Responsibilities:

API Security Architecture

  • Design and govern secure architecture patterns for Ford's high-traffic, business-critical APIs, embedding security and governance directly into the API lifecycle.
  • Partner with platform engineering to strengthen authentication, authorization, and threat protection across the API gateway ecosystem.
  • Champion a shift-left approach to API security and compliance by embedding automated checks directly into the build phase, catching issues early in the development lifecycle. Familiarity with security tooling such as FOSSA, Cycode, 42Crunch, Cloud Armor, PRISMA is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with open-source tools, applying buy vs build diligently and make decisions.
  • Building engineering prototypes which is kind of R&D (POC, Reference architecture), pre- implementation prototypes which are building blocks which perform in pre-production with minor tweaks.

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Architect a unified, vendor-agnostic identity fabric across Ford's global enterprise, resolving the complexity of a multi-IdP environment while eliminating vendor lock-in.
  • Define modern application authorization patterns — including OAuth On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flows and delegated access models — that scale securely across applications, APIs, and AI agents.
  • Establish governance standards spanning workforce, customer, and machine/non-human identities.

AI & Agent Security Governance

  • Define and enforce enterprise-wide governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills.
  • Partner with the Platform team (EPEO) to evaluate and govern the enterprise, AI Gateway.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agent-building ecosystem — low-code/no-code and pro-code options using Microsoft and Gemini Enterprise, plus hands-on expertise in the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) — to guide secure, scalable agent adoption.
  • Collaborate with GDAI and data/AI teams to keep governance aligned with the pace of enterprise AI innovation.

Engineering Excellence – Patterns & Reference Architecture

  • Design and publish reusable patterns and reference architectures for AI solutions, giving teams across Ford consistent, secure building blocks rather than ad-hoc implementations.
  • Build starter apps/templates for the Google ADK, providing pro-code agent developers a secure, governed foundation to build from.
  • Define reference implementations mapping OAuth OBO flows with Microsoft Agent ID, ensuring agents securely act on behalf of users with proper identity context and audit trails.
  • Continuously evolve these patterns as Microsoft, Google, and other providers update their agent identity and authorization models.
  • Ensure starter kits and patterns are pre-approved, governance-compliant building blocks reducing time-to-production for new AI use cases.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

  • Lead strategy for multi-cloud interoperability, ensuring consistent, portable security architecture across cloud providers.
  • Maintain a strong command of GCP architecture — scalability, resiliency, and cost/FinOps — to guide sound, cost-conscious infrastructure decisions. Partnering with FinOps EPEO team for the cost of architecture.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and EPEO infrastructure teams to ensure governance controls are technically enforceable across tooling and platforms.
  • Architect security solutions that directly protect and enable Ford's core business platforms — eCommerce, Ford Credit (global banking and financial services), and global retail/commercial fleet customer platforms.
  • Balance security rigor with speed-to-market for digital initiatives.

Applied AI & Insights

  • Apply predictive AI models to real enterprise use cases, delivering actionable insights that inform security, architecture, and business strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cybersecurity, platform (EPEO), infrastructure, and data/AI(GDAI) teams to align governance and reference architectures with evolving platform capabilities and enterprise roadmaps.
  • Serve as a key architectural liaison between security, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of 20+ polyglot architects (Java, UI, AI, Python, GCP).
  • Build a culture of Engineering Excellence — driving technical rigor, continuous learning, and cross-skilling.
  • Set team goals and objectives, priorities, and development paths aligned with enterprise architecture measure success by defining OKRs and KPIs.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a Director-level technical authority on identity, API, and AI security governance, representing Enterprise Architecture in senior technical and business forums.
  • Proactively shape Ford's approach to secure, scalable AI adoption — anticipating emerging risks and technologies ahead of business impact.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, cybersecurity architecture, or platform engineering, including significant time in identity & access management (IAM) and API security architecture.
  • Proven, hands-on experience architecting multi-IdP identity environments, with deep knowledge of protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML — including practical implementation of OBO (On-Behalf-Of) flows and delegated authorization patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience with API gateway architecture, threat protection, and API lifecycle governance at enterprise scale.
  • Practical, current knowledge of AI agent frameworks and ecosystems — Microsoft Copilot Studio/Agent frameworks, Gemini Enterprise, and the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) including building or evaluating low-code/no-code vs. pro-code agent solutions.
  • Working understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging standards for AI agent governance and interoperability.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture, including scalability, resiliency patterns, and cost/FinOps optimization.
  • Experience applying predictive AI/ML models to business use cases, with the ability to translate technical outcomes into business insight.
  • Proven track record leading and developing large, technically diverse teams(20+), ideally across Java, Python, UI, AI, and cloud disciplines.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to represent technical strategy to senior business and technology leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-cloud architecture experience (GCP plus AWS/Azure), particularly around interoperability and portability of security controls.
  • Championing a shift-left approach to API security and compliance by embedding automated checks directly into the build phase, catching issues early in the development lifecycle; familiarity with security tooling such as FOSSA, Cycode, 42Crunch, and PRISMA is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or large-scale digital/eCommerce enterprise environment.
  • Relevant certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect or any security/architecture certifications are a plus.
  • Experience contributing to or leading greenfield architecture practices — building governance frameworks, standards, and teams from the ground up rather than inheriting mature processes.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (financial services, banking/fintech) given the role's proximity to Ford Credit's global banking and financial platforms.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title : AVP - DC Automation

Department : IT

ROLE SUMMARY
The Assistant Vice President of Data Center Automation is a senior leadership role responsible for driving the automation, optimization, and security of data center operations. This position oversees Building Management System (BMS) operations, and OSS/BSS (Operational Support Systems/Business Support Systems) functions, ensuring seamless integration, efficiency, and resilience across all systems. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Technical Scope of Work
1. System Architecture Design - Must
  • Define and document the overall control architecture , including:
    • PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
    • OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
    • Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
  • Develop IO lists , control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS) .
  • Coordinate between MEP consultants , controls contractors , and operations to align automation design.
2. Control System Development - Must
  • Author control sequence logic for:
    • Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
    • Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
  • Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
  • Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
  • Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC-UA , and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation.
3. Commissioning Validation - Must
  • Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
  • Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
  • Oversee integration testing with DCIM , AIops , or energy optimization platforms.
4. OT Cybersecurity Governance - Great to Have
  • Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
    • Network segregation between IT and OT.
    • Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
    • Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
  • Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
  • Maintain system access logs , firmware inventories, and security posture reports.
5. Operations Enablement - Must
  • Create OM procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
    • Change management and version control.
    • Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
    • Data historian configuration and retention policies.
  • Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
6. Continuous Optimization - Must
  • Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
    • Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
    • Integrate AI models for predictive control.
    • Support digital twin deployment and data validation.
Deliverables
  • Control Philosophy Document (CPD)
  • Functional Design Specification (FDS)
  • Control System Architecture Network Diagram
  • FAT/SAT Test Protocols Reports
  • OT Security Policy for Automation Systems
  • Standardized Tag List Alarm Database
QUALIFICATION EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience, Mechanical, Electrical or Controls degree preferred.
- Excellent understanding of industry-standard electrical and mechanical systems used in data centers, as well as controls/monitoring systems.
- Experience of 15 + years in designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, Building Management System (BMS) Controls software and networks.
- Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

- Project coordination experience with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements for data centers.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
jobDescription:
Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do
  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Who You Are (Must-Haves)
  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)
  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

jobDescription:
ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS

For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. We re proud to support the people behind the work, those showing up and making an impact every shift. We re a purpose-driven team with a strong commitment to community, collaboration, and service. Here, you ll find a culture that values connection, fresh perspectives, and real impact. From the start, we re committed to giving you an authentic look at life at UA Brands and how you can grow, contribute, and make your mark.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role follows a permanent work schedule of 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, Monday through Friday.

We are looking for an applied AI and automation engineer to build and ship practical tools that make UA s operations faster and more reliable. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: the person takes problems and priorities defined by leadership and turns them into working software AI agents, automations, scripts, and integrations that connect our systems and remove manual work. Success is measured by what ships and the results it produces, not by research or strategy. A core part of the job is technical judgment: knowing when a problem genuinely needs AI versus when a simpler, reliable rule-based tool is the right answer, and building accordingly.

Initial work centers on UA s AI and automation roadmap: building and deploying managed AI agents for operations use cases such as order and return exception handling and inbound document processing, automating manual B2B and customer-service workflows, and integrating these solutions with existing systems including Dynamics AX, Zoom Contact Center, and Microsoft 365. The role works under the direction of the Project Manager and partners with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope and deliver.

WHAT YOU LL DO

  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations for prioritized operations use cases (e.g., order and return exception handling; inbound document processing against Dynamics AX).
  • Build deterministic automation tools and scripts where business logic is rule-based (e.g., conditional product removal, dormant account review), reserving AI for inputs that are genuinely unstructured.
  • Collaborate with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope, validate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Document builds, configurations, and runbooks, and support handoff to operations and other teams.
  • Evaluate vendor and platform AI capabilities to inform build-versus-buy decisions and avoid duplicating features already on a vendor roadmap.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between AI/automation solutions and existing systems (Dynamics AX 2012 R3 via SFTP, Zoom Contact Center, Microsoft 365).
  • Automate manual operations and workflows (e.g., Pardot form and order entry, alerting and escalation routing).
  • Test, monitor, and report on the accuracy, performance, and ROI of deployed AI and automation solutions; flag and resolve failures.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve tools already running in production.
  • Translate leadership objectives and business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or an equivalent programming language) for developing automations, scripts, and system integrations.
  • Sound judgment to determine when a problem is best addressed using AI versus deterministic or rule-based solutions.
  • Strong experience in debugging, testing, deploying, and monitoring production-grade solutions.
  • Proficiency in API and data integration, including file-based exchanges, SFTP, and integrations with legacy applications and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool/function calling.
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and structured data management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and functional prototypes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor s degree or equivalent demonstrated experience with a Specialization or Major in Computer Science or Data Science or Computer Engineering or equivalent stream.

TYPE OF EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

More than 2 years of hands-on experience in:

  • Designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered or automation solutions in production environments (beyond academic projects, prototypes, or demonstrations).
  • Integrating systems and data through APIs, SFTP/file-based exchanges, and legacy or ERP platforms.
  • Building and implementing solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications:

Candidates with hands-on experience using LLM APIs and agent frameworks (such as LangChain or LangGraph), along with experience integrating AI solutions with ERP and legacy enterprise systems, will be given preference.

WHERE YOU LL WORK - PERMANENT WORK FROM HOME (India)

This is a permanent remote role based in India, allowing you to work exclusively from your home within India, with no daily commute.

Remote employees are expected to be available and actively working during their teams designated core business hours to ensure effective collaboration. The company will provide all required computer equipment for business use.

This role may require occasional business travel to our U.S. headquarters, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Situated in one of the countrys most scenic coastal destinations, Fort Lauderdale is known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant waterfront, and year-round warm climate. Candidates who already hold a valid U.S. Business Visa (B1/B2) will have an advantage.

WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must have a dedicated, quiet, and distraction-free home workspace that supports productive work throughout their scheduled shift, with no conflicting personal or professional responsibilities.

The workspace must also include:

  • A reliable high-speed internet connection with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps.
  • A minimum of 9 hours of uninterrupted power backup to ensure business continuity during working hours.

WHY YOU LL LOVE WORKING HERE

UA BRANDS offers a full range of benefits that address both your health and financial needs.

UA IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Executive Support | Office of the Managing Director | Pune-PCMC Reports to: Managing Director (exclusively) | Works closely with: COO, Head-BD, VP-BD, Finance, Legal |


THE ROLE
The Personal Assistant / Personal Secretary to the Managing Director at ICON Turnkey Ventures LLP is one of the most trusted positions in the organisation. The MD is the face of ICON to clients, banks, government bodies, industry associations, and strategic partners and is simultaneously driving the company from 20-25 Crore toward 100 Crore+ by FY 2028-29. The PA/PS is the person who ensures none of that falls through the cracks.

This role exists to multiply the MD's effectiveness by protecting their time, managing their information flow, coordinating their commitments, and ensuring that every interaction the MD has is well-prepared, well-documented, and well- followed up. The MD should never walk into a meeting unprepared, miss a deadline, or waste time on tasks that can be owned by this role.
The standard for this role in one line: The MD's calendar, correspondence, commitments, and priorities are managed so completely and proactively that the MD's first question in the morning is never 'what do I have today?' because the answer is already on their desk, their phone, and their mind before they ask.


Zero

24 Hrs
Correspondence

100%

Confidentiality Standard


MD+1
One Step Ahead At All Times

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ROLES
1. Calendar & Schedule Management
Own the MD's calendar completely schedule, reschedule, and protect meetings with clients, banks, government bodies, partners, and internal stakeholders. The MD's time is ICON's most valuable resource; this role is the gatekeeper.
Maintain a daily briefing sheet for the MD prepared before 8:30 AM every working day listing the day's meetings (with names, context, and objectives), key deadlines, pending decisions awaiting the MD, and any correspondence requiring the MD's attention.
Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively before the MD is asked. A scheduling clash that reaches the MD is a failure of this role.
Plan and coordinate the MD's travel client visits across Pune-PCMC belt, Mumbai-MMR, and outstation booking transport, accommodation, and meeting logistics in advance. Prepare a travel itinerary document for every outstation trip.
Manage recurring commitments weekly pipeline reviews, monthly bank meetings, quarterly board reviews, and industry association events ensuring these are diarised, reminders set, and preparation materials ready in advance.
2. Correspondence & Communication Management
Screen, prioritise, and manage the MD's email inbox and physical correspondence categorising by urgency and importance, drafting responses for MD review, and routing non-MD items to the COO, BD team, or relevant function.
Draft professional correspondence on behalf of the MD letters to clients, banks, government authorities, legal firms, and industry bodies in precise, formal English and Marathi as required. Every outgoing letter reflects ICON's professional standard.


Prepare MOM (Minutes of Meeting) for all meetings attended by the MD issued within 24 hours of the meeting to all relevant parties, with action items, owners, and deadlines clearly listed.
Follow up on action items from MD meetings tracking who owes what by when, chasing overdue items, and presenting a weekly action tracker to the MD every Monday morning.
Manage the MD's WhatsApp and phone communication support where requested, filter, summarise, and draft responses for high-volume communication during busy periods (board reviews, major bid submissions, banking meetings).
3. Meeting Preparation & Coordination
Prepare a briefing document before every significant MD meeting client background, meeting objective, key discussion points, relevant project history, and any open commercial or relationship items. The MD should never need to ask 'who is this person?' before a meeting.
Arrange all meeting logistics conference room booking, AV setup, tea/coffee/refreshments, printed materials, and visitor reception. Every meeting at ICON's office must run without a logistical failure.
Coordinate pre-meeting inputs from the COO, Head-BD, or Project Managers when the meeting requires technical or commercial context ensuring all information reaches the MD at least 1 hour before the meeting.
Prepare presentation materials, data summaries, and briefing packs for the MD's external presentations board meetings, bank presentations, client capability presentations, and industry forums in coordination with the relevant function head.
4. Document Management & Filing
Maintain a structured document management system for the MD's office contracts, board resolutions, banking documents, legal correspondence, statutory filings, company registration documents, and key agreements both physical and digital, filed systematically and retrievable within minutes.
Track document expiry dates and renewal requirements company registrations, trade licences, ISO certificates, insurance policies, bank guarantee expiry dates, and power of attorney documents. Alert the MD and COO 60 days before any expiry.
Manage all incoming and outgoing couriers, legal notices, regulatory correspondence, and stamped documents
logging every item with the date received, sender, and action taken.
Maintain confidential files board minutes, MD's personal documents, key contracts, and banking
correspondence in a secure, access-controlled system.
5. Liaison & Coordination
Act as the first point of contact for all visitors, callers, and correspondents seeking the MD screening professionally, gathering context, and routing appropriately. Every person who contacts the MD through this role should feel they have been treated with courtesy and professionalism.
Coordinate internally with the COO, Head-BD, Project Managers, Finance, and HR on action items, information requests, and approvals flowing to and from the MD ensuring nothing sits in transit and every request has a response timeline.
Liaise with external parties bank relationship managers, legal retainers, CAs, government departments, client representatives, and courier services on behalf of the MD, with complete professionalism and discretion.
Coordinate MD's participation in industry events, CII/CIDC meetings, chamber of commerce events, and networking forums registration, logistics, preparation materials, and follow-up actions.
6. Office Administration for the MD's Office
Manage procurement of stationery, printing, and office supplies for the MD's office maintaining stock, placing orders, and ensuring nothing runs out.
Process MD's expense claims, travel reimbursements, and vendor invoices coordinating with Finance for timely processing and maintaining records for audit purposes.
Arrange visa applications, passport renewals, and travel documentation for MD's international travel coordinating with the relevant embassy or travel agency well in advance.
Manage petty cash for the MD's office maintaining a cash register, obtaining receipts, and submitting for replenishment on schedule.
7. Confidentiality & Discretion
Handle all information relating to the MD's office, ICON's business strategy, client relationships, financial position, and personnel matters with absolute confidentiality at all times, including outside working hours.
Exercise professional judgement in what is communicated, to whom, and when. The PA/PS will regularly have access to commercially sensitive, legally privileged, and personally private information discretion is not a policy, it is a character requirement for this role.
Sign and adhere to ICON's Non-Disclosure Agreement on joining. Any breach of confidentiality is grounds for immediate termination.

48 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Secretary, or Executive Assistant supporting a senior

Proactive over reactive the PA/PS anticipates what the MD will need before being asked. 'Waiting for

AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.

SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).

Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.

Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.
